autumn-bough.heading: AUTUMN BOUGH.
autumn-bough.flavour: Flesh white, very tender, and with a rich and sweet, yet sprightly flavor.
autumn-bough.quality: regarded by many as one of the best sweet apples of its season for dessert use and is esteemed also for culinary purposes.
autumn-bough.storage: Ripens from 25th of Eighth month to the 20th of Ninth month.
autumn-bough.note: Synonyms Autumn Sweet Bough, Fall Bough, Late Bough, Montgomery Sweet, Philadelphia Sweet. Flavour and season are Parsons (1846) quoted by Beach. Hangs well but does not ship well.
